newsitem.title: USA: Landmark Banc cautious for rest of year.
newsitem.headline: Landmark Banc cautious for rest of year.

text.p: Landmark Bancshares Corp, a bank holding company with assets of about $222 million, said Monday it is guardedly optimistic for the balance of the year.

"Any major increase in interest rates will reduce net income, therefore, we are approaching future quarters with guarded optimism," said Larry Schugart, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.

Landmark today reported earnings for its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended December 31, 1996 rose to $0.35 a share from $0.21 in the same period a year ago. Higher results were due to an increase in net interest income and a gain on the sale of investments.
